dogecoin.text: Imagine coming up off $DOGE out of pure luck and you don't transfer any of that money into XRP
So am I the only person wondering who's paying for these Doge Coin and Bitcoin advertisements all over social media 🤔

Dogecoin's unlimited supply is a bigger inflation nightmare than the Federal Reserve. Every minute, 10,000 new coins hit the market, potentially diluting value faster than any central bank could 🤷🏽‍♂️
